name: pulse-blast-radius
description: Holds risky Bash commands (deletes, destructive git, database resets and migrations, infra teardown), shows what they would change, and waits for Run command or Cancel command. Fork of anthropics/claude-code-playground blast-radius.

measureMigrations.title: Measure migrations
measureMigrations.description: off: a held migration says its pending migrations are not listed, because listing them runs your project's code. on: before you answer, Blast Radius runs the tool's status command (manage.py showmigrations, bin/rails db:migrate:status, alembic history, prisma migrate status) and lists what is pending.
